review.shorterRoute: Reuse native modularStretch and integral expansions, actual Hecke triangular matrices, Fourier uniqueness, sparse-index sums, prescribed root reduction, discriminant-normalized field ratios, native all-level two-generator equality and existing labeled cusp places. Direct Fourier sums replace the external analytic coset-translate framework. Weight-twelve ratios avoid a second general all-weight cusp-map construction. Native coprime lifting and SL2 row completion replace the external unit-lifting and explicit determinant construction. Both coordinates and diamond equivariance belong to one actual full original residue-field homomorphism; its pulled-back valuation is proved to lie above the specified existing base cusp.
assumptionsToDischarge: The source integer-label formula for the actual j_N coordinate is proved from literal raised E4-cube and discriminant expansions in every allowed residue characteristic.

One constructed actual original-field homomorphism has both prescribed source coordinates and signed-translation diamond equivariance, without a map, coefficient-reduction or equivariance certificate.

For every existing primitive full-base cusp label, an actual integral cusp matrix and a genuine original residue-field place are constructed. Its exact base valuation restriction, j-pole and signed-translation stabilizer are proved; no matrix, place or extension certificate remains.
review.remaining: Transporting stabilizers over the whole fiber, cusp double-coset injection and fiber bounds, finite elliptic charts including characteristics two and three, and the reverse genus inequality remain required. Original genus preservation, parabolic integral transfer, exceptional-prime removal, original all-weight association, automorphy and literal higher continuation remain open. Acceptance stays 16/20; DUB17--20 OPEN under the unchanged full contract.
